record.field:
Gentle, restorative yoga and a proper brunch after — the calmest hour of your week.

An unhurried, all-levels flow built around breathing and letting go, not folding yourself into knots. Stay afterward for coffee and a shared table of good food — most people do, and that's rather the point. No experience needed, no special gear, and absolutely no chanting unless you're into it.

When

Sundays, 10:00–11:00am · brunch till noon

Where

The Studio, 42 Fairview Rd

Level

All levels, gentle

Cost

$15 drop-in · includes brunch

record.field:
A neighborhood 5K for every pace — jog it, walk it, or push a stroller around it.

One lap of the park and the river path, marshaled and traffic-free the whole way. There's no clock and no cut-off, and the back of the pack gets the loudest cheer. Every entry goes to the local food bank, with coffee and warm pastries waiting at the finish. Bring the kids, bring the dog, bring the friend who swears they can't run.

When

Sat April 26, 9:00am start

Where

Meet at the Fairview Park gates

Level

All paces, all ages

Cost

$10 suggested donation

record.field:
A six-week beginners' strength course for anyone who's never picked up a weight — or hasn't in years.

Small groups, capped at eight, so nobody gets lost at the back. You'll learn the handful of movements that actually matter, at a pace that assumes you're starting from zero. Our coach walks with you through every session — no jumping ahead, no keeping up. Come as you are, leave a little stronger.

When

Tue & Thu, 6:30–7:30pm · 6 weeks, starts April 14

Where

The Studio, 42 Fairview Rd

Level

Complete beginners welcome

Cost

$90 for the full course · mats & kit provided
